title: Raycast extensions carousel
description: A left-aligned two-tone heading with a pill of category tabs (right on desktop, under it on phones), then a sideways track of tall rounded cards, each washed with its own colour: app tile, name, a small arrow button, a one-line pitch, a hairline and an artwork slot. Cards slide in from the right on load, two round arrows scroll the track, and a 'browse more' link sits at the left.
notes: each card's tone is one of chart-1…5, so the washes follow the theme
needs JavaScript for the tabs and arrows (state, scrollBy); static HTML shows the first tab
